population.label: Population
population.sources: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B01003 “Total Population,”; U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, five-year estimates, 2024, Table DP05 “A.C.S. Demographic and Housing Estimates,”

foreign_born.label: Foreign-born
foreign_born.desc: Percentage of residents born outside the U.S.
foreign_born.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B05002 (Place of Birth by Citizenship Status)

poverty.label: Poverty
poverty.desc: Percentage of population with income in the past 12 months below poverty level
poverty.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, five-year estimates, 2024, Table S1701 (Poverty Status in the Past 12 Months)

deep_poverty.label: Deep poverty
deep_poverty.desc: Percentage of population with incomes no more than half of the federal poverty threshold
deep_poverty.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B17002 (Ratio of Income to Poverty Level in the Past 12 Months)

cost_burden.label: Housing-cost burdened
cost_burden.desc: Percentage of residents paying at least 30 percent of income in rent
cost_burden.sources: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B25070 (Gross Rent as a Percentage of Household Income in the Past 12 Months); U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, five-year estimates, 2024, Table B25072 (Gross Rent as a Percentage of Household Income by Age of Householder)

hh_income.label: Median household income
hh_income.desc: Combined household income in the past 12 months
hh_income.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B19013 (Median Household Income in the Past 12 Months)

homeownership.label: Homeownership
homeownership.desc: Percentage of residential units occupied by homeowners
homeownership.sources: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B25003 (Tenure). U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, five-year estimates, 2024, Table S2502 (Demographic Characteristics for Occupied Housing Units)

labor_force.label: Labor force participation
labor_force.desc: Percentage of population 16 years and older in the labor force (employed or unemployed and looking for work)
labor_force.sources: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B23025 (Employment Status); U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, five-year estimates, 2024, Table S2301 (Employment Status by age & race); U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, five-year estimates, 2024, Table B23001 (Sex by Age by Employment Status for the Population 16 Years and Over)

unemployment.label: Unemployment
unemployment.desc: Percentage of unemployed workers in the labor force
unemployment.source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Local Area Unemployment Statistics: Unemployment Rates for the 50 Largest Cities, 2014-25* Annual Averages

disability.label: Disability
disability.desc: Percentage of civilian noninstitutionalized population with a disability
disability.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, five-year estimates, 2024, Table S1810 (Disability Characteristics)

commute.label: Commute by public transit
commute.desc: Percentage of population using public transit to travel to work
commute.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table S0801 (Commuting Characteristics by Sex)

college.label: College graduates
college.desc: Percentage of adults 25 years or older with a bachelor’s degree or higher
college.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, five-year estimates, 2024, Table S1501 (Educational Attainment)

pre_K.label: Preschool enrollment
pre_K.desc: Percentage of 3- and 4-year-olds enrolled in school
pre_K.source: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table S1401 (School Enrollment)

homicide_capita.label: Homicides
homicide_capita.sources: U.S. Census Bureau, American Community Survey, one-year estimates, 2014-24, Table B01003 “Total Population,”; Police departments of all 10 cities (2014-24)
